variables.name: ADMIN_USERNAME
variables.description: Username required to sign in to the webfit admin interface. Choose the account name the app owner will use.

variables.name: ADMIN_PASSWORD
variables.description: Password required to sign in to the webfit admin interface. Set this to a strong private password before exposing the app.

variables.name: SESSION_SECRET
variables.description: Random secret used to sign browser session cookies. Generate a long unpredictable value and keep it private.
